Various policies of Brampton Plan apply to lands within the Heritage Heights area.  Refer to text.  Heritage Heights is a designated growth area planned to accommodate significant residential, employment, institutional, recreational, and commercial development. The area is intended to evolve as a complete community supported by integrated transportation networks, infrastructure, parks, and public services.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
